title: Unit 3 — APA-03 Processor Cooling-Stack Analyzer
description: Build three documented functions for TIM resistance, processor node temperatures, and thermal margin; analyze five power levels; run the public check; and download the complete project.
note: Running the public check or Run Tests never submits anything to Canvas. Download All (.zip) automatically leaves out U03_APA03_ProcessorCooling_PublicCheck.m -- Canvas only wants your main script and the three function files.
